description: This file defines the ConceptStopWord class, which represents stop words (common words to be filtered out) associated with a particular locale, used for indexing and search filtering in the OpenMRS system.

classes.name: ConceptStopWord
classes.description: Represents a stop word for concept indexing, including the word value and locale.

methods.name: ConceptStopWord
methods.description: Default constructor for creating an empty ConceptStopWord instance.

methods.name: ConceptStopWord
methods.description: Constructor for creating a ConceptStopWord with a specific value and default locale.

methods.name: ConceptStopWord
methods.description: Constructor for creating a ConceptStopWord with a specific value and locale.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the stop word value, converting it to uppercase if not empty.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the locale associated with this stop word.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the locale for the stop word, defaulting to system locale if null.

methods.name: getConceptStopWordId
methods.description: Returns the internal concept stop word ID.

methods.name: setConceptStopWordId
methods.description: Sets the internal concept stop word ID.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Provides the ID of the object, used for persistence.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ConceptStopWord, including value and locale.
